description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 29.04.2019 to 05.05.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It deals with the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, which is a regulatory matter. The content involves setting, modifying, and rescinding regulations (exchange rates) for compliance with customs laws, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel/structure changes, land, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
